title: Genesis 22:9 — Abraham builds the altar and binds Isaac on the wood
summary: The Akedah: Genesis 22:9 in English and Hebrew. They reach the place God told Abraham of; he builds the altar, arranges the wood, binds Isaac and lays him on the altar on top of the wood. The word את (et) is shown before 'the altar', 'the wood' and 'Isaac', underlined in grey, brown and red with the matching Hebrew words; the word God (and Hebrew האלהים) has multi-coloured letters.

text.text: 9 Then they came to the place of which God had told him; and Abraham built את the altar there and arranged את the wood, and bound his son את Isaac and laid him on the altar, on top of the wood.
9 ויבאו אל־המקום אשר אמר־לו האלהים ויבן שם אברהם את־המזבח ויערך את־העצים ויעקד את־יצחק בנו וישם אתו על־המזבח ממעל לעצים׃

words.gloss: alef-tav; untranslated direct-object marker before the altar, the wood and Isaac

keywords: laid him on the altar on top of the wood
